newsitem.title: USA: Best Buy says Q1 same-store sales off.
newsitem.headline: Best Buy says Q1 same-store sales off.

text.p: Best Buy Co Inc said same-store sales for the first fiscal quarter ended May 31 decreased eight percent in comparison with a four percent same-store sales increase during the same period last year.
Total sales for the first fiscal quarter were $1.608 billion, a two percent decrease compared with the $1.637 billion reported in the first quarter last year, Best Buy said.
Chief financial officer Allen Lenzmeier said, "First quarter sales were in line with our expectations."

He said, "The lower sales level, as compared to last year, is attributed to the continued softness in consumer electronics and lower average selling prices of personal computers. However, the company did experience gains in sales of major appliances, performance service plans and entertainment software."
In the first quarter, the company said it opened two of 13 planned new stores for fiscal 1998.
One store was opened in Mentor, Ohio, and the other in The Woodlands, Texas. A Merrillville, Ind., store relocated in May.
Six new stores are scheduled to open during the second quarter, Best Buy said.
First quarter operating results will be released the morning of June 18, 1997, the company said.
The company operates 274 stores in 32 states.
